scope: one region; three coordinator members and three PostgreSQL nodes; grouped AZ failure injection is untested

cases.sql-fencing: new generation accepted, old rejected before and after resource restart; one effect per operation
cases.sync-network: old primary demotes after DCS isolation, active connection stops writing, new primary preserves acknowledged orders, former primary returns as replica
cases.async-loss: stop replication before acknowledged writes, lose primary, observe predetermined missing order ids, rebuild former primary
cases.controller-pause: pause only Patroni, keep PostgreSQL and existing connection alive, allow lease expiry and promotion, detect successful stale write as unsafe model

fallback: retain input history, client responses and SQL snapshots; independent offline verifier must classify safe cases and detect the deliberately unsafe cases
scopeClarification: After the pilot, the placement context was clarified: only process and network faults were injected, no AZ-level group failure.
